body: In the darkness, ※13⛬ was deep in slumber when a sticky sensation spread across his face, jolting him awake.
The surroundings were still pitch black, and he couldn't see his hand in front of his face. ※13⛬ only felt something squirming uneasily beside him.
He instinctively reached out to touch it, but the sensation startled him; the familiar soft fur of his ※4⛬ had become somewhat prickly, a texture that a ※4⛬ should never have.

※13⛬'s heart suddenly quickened, and a feeling of unease surged within him. In this cramped underground cave, there should be no other creatures besides his ※4⛬, but this strange touch made him wonder if an unfamiliar ※1⛬ had intruded.
Just as ※13⛬ was filled with worry, a cry of “※12⛬… ※12⛬” broke the silence.
It was clearly ※4⛬'s voice, but strangely, ※13⛬ could clearly understand its meaning:
“Master, Master, you're finally awake! This ※4⛬ was so worried.”
※13⛬ was filled with surprise. He knew this must be related to his previous experience and that mysterious energy, but he had no time to ponder it now.
Unable to see clearly in the dark, he quickly fumbled for his flashlight. As a beam of light cut through the darkness, ※13⛬ finally saw the situation inside the cave.
When his gaze landed on the ※1⛬ in front of him, he couldn't help but widen his eyes, his face filled with astonishment.

The original ※4⛬ had actually evolved into a ※3⛬. Its once short and sturdy body had become taller and more robust, and the spikes on its back were even sharper, glinting coldly under the flashlight's illumination.
※13⛬ was completely stunned. He couldn't figure out what was going on.

He knew that ※1⛬ evolution usually required many conditions: good condition, no injuries, and being conscious were all indispensable. But ※4⛬ had clearly been unconscious before, so how did it suddenly evolve?
Did it wake up and evolve while he was asleep?
※13⛬ was full of questions, his brows tightly furrowed, his eyes revealing deep confusion.
※3⛬, seeing ※13⛬ awake, excitedly bounced a few times in place. Its spikes made a slight rubbing sound with its movements, and the ground trembled slightly beneath its stomping.
Its eyes were fixed on ※13⛬, filled with affection and reliance, and it occasionally let out joyful cries. The sound echoed in the cramped underground cave, carrying a hint of excitement and delight.
※13⛬ looked at the ※3⛬ in front of him. Although he was full of questions, he felt more joy and relief.
He slowly stood up, his body still a bit numb, seemingly stiff from sleep, and his steps were slightly unsteady.
He walked towards ※3⛬, reaching out to gently stroke its hard shell, feeling the cold yet solid touch, his heart filled with emotion.
“※3⛬, you really evolved. This is incredible.”
※13⛬'s voice carried an undeniable tremor, a mix of excitement over this unexpected surprise and deep confusion about the unknown cause.
※3⛬ seemed to understand ※13⛬'s words, nuzzling ※13⛬'s hand affectionately with its large head.
A low, contented purr rumbled in its throat, as if responding to ※13⛬'s emotions, or perhaps charming him for more affection.
※13⛬ carefully examined ※3⛬. He could smell a faint earthy scent emanating from ※3⛬, mixed with its unique, slightly pungent body odor.
This familiar yet strange scent made ※13⛬ feel ※4⛬'s transformation even more vividly.

※13⛬'s mind kept pondering the reason for ※4⛬'s evolution. He guessed that perhaps during the process of clearing ※4⛬'s energy channels and healing its injuries, he had inadvertently triggered some hidden evolution mechanism.
Or perhaps that mysterious energy had caused a special reaction within ※4⛬, prompting it to complete its evolution while unconscious.
Although these were just his guesses, he wasn't sure if ※4⛬'s evolution was due to him.
But regardless, ※3⛬'s evolution was undoubtedly a delightful event.
“Congratulations, ※3⛬, you finally evolved! From now on, we'll have to work even harder, ※3⛬.”
※13⛬ said with a smile, his eyes filled with anticipation for the future.
※3⛬, hearing ※13⛬'s praise, slightly lowered its head, seemingly a bit shy.
In fact, it was also very confused; it couldn't understand how it had suddenly evolved.
It clearly remembered being severely injured before, feeling at the time that it was doomed and would surely die.
When it slowly woke up, it found that not only had it not died, but it had miraculously evolved, which left it bewildered and utterly confused.

However, it also recalled the light emanating from its Master before it fainted. At the time, that light felt warm and comfortable, but it still couldn't resist the invasion of its injuries and fainted.
Now, thinking about it, could it be that the light from its Master saved it?
And ※13⛬, looking at the evolved ※3⛬, felt a burning fighting spirit rekindle in his eyes. He tightly clenched his fists, as if declaring his determination to fate.
A firm smile appeared on his face, a smile filled with infinite expectation and confidence for the future.
He thought to himself that this could be considered a blessing in disguise; with ※3⛬'s strong protection, he should be able to return safely.
※3⛬ seemed to sense ※13⛬'s determination, raising its thick, powerful front claws high and letting out a loud ※17⛬.
The sound was powerful and resonant, as if it could break through the dark underground cave, filled with endless strength and fearless courage.
It seemed to be showing ※13⛬ its determination, and also declaring its new life and strength to the entire world.
※13⛬ also noticed that ※3⛬'s condition was indeed excellent, but he was still very curious about the specific changes after ※3⛬'s evolution, so he decided to use the system to scan ※3⛬.
※13⛬ remembered that the last time he scanned ※4⛬'s information, it was like this:
Category: Mouse ※1⛬
Level: 22 (Normal)
Aptitude: ※5⛬
Attribute: Ground
Height: 0.6 m
Weight: 12.0 kg

Training Method: It is recommended to provide ※4⛬ with more nutritional supplements. It previously had some congenital deficiencies, so it is advisable to use some ※14⛬ that strengthens the foundation and cultivates vitality.

Previously, with the system's help, ※4⛬'s training was not bad, but it was still limited by its aptitude and resources, and the training time was short, so there were still many areas that needed improvement.
